title: Get to know System: Configurations, Notifications and more
summary: Tour of Configurations, Notifications, Audit Log, Access Log, Error Log and Import Data: what each screen is for.

steps.title: System
steps.details: We'll go through Configurations, Notifications, Audit Log, Access Log, Error Log and Import Data.

steps.title: Configurations
steps.details: Technical configuration keys (integrations, messaging, behavior). Administrators only. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Notifications
steps.details: Which internal notifications each person gets and through which channel. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Audit Log
steps.details: History of changes to the data: what was modified, by whom and when. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Access Log
steps.details: Who signed in to the system, when and from where. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Error Log
steps.details: Recorded technical errors, useful for reporting them to support. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Import Data
steps.details: Wizard to import patients and other data from Excel or CSV: it maps columns, validates and only then imports. It has 2 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
